Strategy: Flatten the sweet band by halving its penalty and punish the mid band by thirty, so sweet residuals outrank most other gaps while awkward ones fall hard. This changes ranking inside both bands instead of adding flat bonuses, but the halving may over-promote loose fits.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [(-(r - item) - 30 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else (-(r - item) / 2 if r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else -(r - item))) for r in bins]
```
